reviews.t: During the recovery from hurricane Helene the church family was a God sent for our community. They provided much needed support not only in the form of supplies but in a smiling face and kind encouraging words. They treated us like we were a part of the church family even though we had never been to the church before. They truly are a shining example of how Gods people should treat each other. We have been Blessed to have experienced such unconditional support from strangers in such a difficult situation. Thank you to all of the church members for all you have / are doing for our community and for us.

I Grew Up in SE North Carolina and now Reside in Michigan. I Follow Swannanoa Valley Church Online and Watch their Recorded Sermons, with God's Word Open and Following Along. I Praise The Lord for this Tabernacle of Meeting, The Body of Believers there, and The Ministry Staff, for they Worship and Preach in Spirit and Truth. They don't Tickle Ears, but Preach ALL of God's Word and dont sugar coat Nothing. I Need Good Preachin like this because much of "the church" has Watered down God's Word and don't Preach Repentance like Jesus did, and Still Does through the Power of His Holy Spirit today in those who Do His Will, being about The Father's Business. As a Father Love a Son, He Correct him who errs, struggles, or is deceived, and puts him back on The Way Everlasting, with Christ Jesus. I See, Hear, and Feel The Holy Spirit of God in Swannanoa Valley Church...Praise Ye The Lord! Such a Blessing☀️🛡🙏🏼🇺🇲
I got to know this church during Hurricane Helene recovery...they are a caring community.
